benchmark: cross-well F3 Vc, held-out well F03-4
noise_note: Simulated Gaussian perturbations on subsampled coordinates. Not calibrated laboratory uncertainties.
d2: second difference along the window index, stencil 1, -2, 1
alpha_selection: lowest validation mean of per-window RMSE; ties keep the smaller alpha; test targets are not used
pairing: same measurement seed as the model seed; Omega then one standard normal draw, scaled by each noise level
grid_policy: do not change alpha_grid after test scores are known
